level: Level 1 (local Paynow protocol simulator; no provider, no money)

results.title: Garage A connects its OWN Paynow merchant (USD + ZWG); keys sealed, never returned; not payable until verified
Connection refusals: mechanic, customer, InnBucks in ZWG, "ZIG", no attestation, another garage’s integration, a second connection
Verification refusals: the garage itself, an operator who is a garage member, incomplete evidence, no note, no per-currency evidence, a currency that differs
An independent operator verifies; the SERVER proves every key with an authenticated Paynow trace; the customer can now pay

option.simulation_notice: Simulated Paynow — local test environment. No real money moves.

notices.no_redirect_proof: Coming back from Paynow is not proof of payment. CarUp checks with Paynow.
notices.cannot_cancel: Paynow cannot cancel a payment request, so it can still be completed. While CarUp holds the amount for it, a payment you complete counts on the invoice.
notices.channel: Through the garage’s own Paynow account. Money paid this way goes to the garage, not to CarUp.

results.title: R1 (ICR-S2): a wrong key is refused at connect in the same words as another garage’s ID, and reserves nothing; a pending merchant is not "connected"; a rejected ID cools down
A customer starts an EcoCash request and never approves it; while CarUp’s collection time runs, no operator can release it

paynow.provider_status_label: Waiting for you to approve the payment on your phone
paynow.instructions: Dial *151*2*4# and enter your EcoCash PIN to approve the payment request sent to your phone.

results.title: R1: a second unapproved EcoCash request, started now so that CarUp’s time runs out with the first
R1: three more unapproved requests, started now so that CarUp’s time runs out with the first (cases G2, G3, G4)
A request whose reply is lost while Paynow's trace keeps failing stays HELD and unconfirmed (never a second request)
Web checkout: a browser return is NOT payment; the signed status update + a fresh poll is; one canonical row, one receipt
Duplicate callbacks: Paynow’s resend of the same signed update is a duplicate (one observation, one allocation, one receipt)
EcoCash (Paynow test number 0771111111): pending "approve on your phone", then paid from Paynow’s own update

pending.provider_status_label: Waiting for you to approve the payment on your phone
pending.instructions: Dial *151*2*4# and enter your EcoCash PIN to approve the payment request sent to your phone.

results.title: OneMoney (test number 0773333333): Paynow reports Failed — nothing counted, the room is released

paynow.provider_status_label: Not completed — Paynow reports the payment was cancelled or failed; nothing was charged
paynow.instructions: Approve the OneMoney payment request sent to your phone with your OneMoney PIN.

results.title: Input refusals reserve nothing: an invalid phone, a method the garage did not enable, InnBucks for ZWG
InnBucks: the customer gets Paynow’s authorization code; the payment counts only when Paynow says Paid

paynow.provider_status_label: Waiting for you to pay with the InnBucks code (not counted yet)
paynow.instructions: Pay with the InnBucks app using the authorization code, USD only.

results.title: O’mari: a wrong one-time password is refused and recorded; the right one completes an authenticated payment
ZWG: a ZWG invoice is paid through the garage’s ZWG integration; ISO code ZWG everywhere, never "ZIG"
Currency mismatch: garage B has no ZWG integration — no ZWG checkout, nothing reserved, never converted
A status update signed with the WRONG key is refused (the one identical answer), recorded for the operator, and changes nothing
A correctly signed update TAMPERED after signing (amount), and an unsigned one, are refused
Cross-garage: an update for garage A’s payment signed with garage B’s REAL key is refused
Cross-collection: a GENUINE signed Paid for one payment, posted to another payment’s resulturl, is refused (binding)
Unknown, malformed and non-Paynow collection ids get the same answer as a forgery (no oracle; independent review S5)
Authority: another customer and another garage cannot read, verify, stop, reconcile or see a garage A Paynow payment

customer_row_paynow.provider_status_label: Waiting for you to approve the payment on your phone
customer_row_paynow.instructions: Dial *151*2*4# and enter your EcoCash PIN to approve the payment request sent to your phone.

facts.next_step: Complete this request, or check its status. Do not start another payment for this amount.

results.title: Amount mismatch: Paynow reports Paid for a different amount — under review, not counted
A lost initiate reply is recovered by an authenticated TRACE — never by sending the payment twice

paynow.provider_status_label: Waiting for you to approve the payment on your phone

results.title: Paynow refuses the request: nothing exists at Paynow, the collection closes, the room is free
The refused request existed at Paynow after all: its later SIGNED Paid binds late into an operator review — never lost, never counted (independent review P1)
A failed provider read fabricates nothing; the next read works
Stop vs pay: the customer stops, Paynow cannot cancel, the room stays held — then the customer approves anyway: counted once

stop: Paynow cannot cancel a payment request, so it can still be completed. While CarUp holds the amount for it, a payment you complete counts on the invoice.

results.title: Concurrency: five simultaneous Paynow requests for the whole balance — exactly one reserves it and exactly one reaches Paynow
Concurrency: five simultaneous resends of a Paid update — one allocation, one receipt
A CarUp refund of a Paynow payment is refused with the truth: refund in the Paynow dashboard (no merchant refund API)

details.guidance: Paynow does not let CarUp refund. Refund the customer in your Paynow dashboard; CarUp records it when Paynow reports it.

results.title: Dispute then resolution: Disputed holds the money (under review, not counted); Paid again counts it again — each a NEW event
Paynow reports the garage refunded in its dashboard: CarUp counts nothing for it, voids the receipt, tells the customer, and asks an operator to confirm the amount
CarUp’s collection time passes: the request is still HELD (Paynow cannot cancel) and listed for the operator, never for the garage
The operator releases the hold after a FRESH authenticated unpaid read; the room is free again
The operator releases the UNCONFIRMED request after expiry and a fresh trace attempt; Paynow's late Paid then counts only into free room (independent review P2)

listed.provider_status_label: CarUp’s time for this request has passed, but Paynow cannot cancel it. The amount stays reserved while CarUp checks with Paynow (not counted).

facts.provider: Not confirmed: CarUp has not heard whether Paynow received this request
facts.next_step: The garage must not record this amount as paid unless the customer really paid it. CarUp keeps it reserved until Paynow answers or an operator releases it.

results.title: Late money with no room left: the garage took cash for the whole balance, then the customer approves the released request — unallocated money for an operator, never a double count
R1 (ICR-M1): Paid, then Paynow reverses it, then an operator settles outside CarUp: never counted again, no new receipt, the garage records its cash, a later Refunded still acts

customer_facts.provider: A status CarUp does not recognise
customer_facts.next_step: If you also paid through Paynow, check its status and tell the garage.

results.title: R1 (ICR-M3): new money after a settlement is never dropped and never allocated: it opens a review the operator sees; the same report again adds nothing
R1 (ICR-M2): Paid, Disputed, Paid, Disputed through Paynow’s own signed updates on the real resulturl: each is applied; none is a resend
R1 (ICR-S1): variants of a captured signed update (padding, an empty field, a lower-case hash) are one message on the real route: no Paynow read, no row, no money
R1 (ICR-M2): an update whose confirming poll disagrees is answered non-2xx, so Paynow resends; once the poll agrees it applies
R1 (ICR-S1, PFR-M3): a replayed captured update costs at most its own budget of Paynow reads and no rows, then answers non-2xx; ordinary reads and other messages still work
R1 (ICR-M4): a dispute Paynow never speaks of again has an exit: not "acknowledged", but settled outside CarUp, which counts nothing and frees the room for real cash
R1 (ICR-M5, M6): a Disputed with another amount is a dispute, not a mismatch; a Refunded with another figure applies in full and keeps the figure as evidence
R1 (ICR-W2, W6): a released request tells the customer not to approve it and offers nothing to act on; the operator still sees and can read it, with no release

facts.provider: Waiting for approval on the phone
facts.next_step: Do not approve the old request on your phone. If you already did, check its status before paying again.

results.title: R1 (duplicate payments): money reaches Paynow on a released request though Paynow’s update was lost: the next Pay reads it first and refuses; nothing new is reserved
R1 (ICR-W1, W3): every row of this run reads truthfully: no "nothing was paid" while Paynow reports money, no "Paid" unless counted
R1 (PFR-H3): late money under review on a closed request: no new request is offered or accepted until the review ends
R1 (PFR-H4): a released request is paid late: it counts, the request now holding the room is told not to complete it, and its own money is reviewed, never counted twice

detail.next_step: Do not complete this request: this invoice no longer needs it. If you already paid it, check its status and ask the garage.

results.title: R1 (PFR-M1): money held at Paynow past CarUp’s time: release stays refused; an operator opens a review and settles it, the room is free, later money is reviewed

listed.reason: Paynow reports money on this request. If that never changes, open a review.

results.title: R1 (PFR-H2): a reviewed Cancelled after money: never "nothing was charged", nothing to complete, and the operator can release it, so the room is not held forever

detail.sentence: CarUp reviewed Paynow’s latest word on this request and does not count it. The amount stays reserved until CarUp releases it.
detail.next_step: Do not pay again yet. Ask the garage: Paynow may still hold this money.

results.title: R1 (PFR-M5): Paynow refuses, CarUp closes, then Paynow’s signed word shows the request exists: closed words, nothing to act on, and paying again warns about it

detail.sentence: CarUp closed this request, but Paynow may still have it. It is not counted on this invoice.
detail.next_step: Do not approve this request on your phone: CarUp closed it. If you already did, check its status and tell the garage.
detail.earlier_request: An earlier Paynow request for this invoice is no longer in use. Paynow cannot cancel it, so do not approve it on your phone. CarUp checks it with Paynow again before starting a new request.

results.title: R1 (CERT-1): Paynow disputes a payment after refunding it: the dispute stays open for an operator, in no one's name; nothing counts; the customer is told to wait
R1 (CERT-3, CERT-4): a review with money reported cannot be closed as refunded, and an invoice with a review open cannot be voided
Availability: a garage cannot switch Paynow; the operator switches it off (checkouts refused) and on, with a reason
Suspension: the operator suspends garage B’s Paynow merchant — B cannot take Paynow payments; the audit trail records it
Provider errors and merchant history are visible to the operator — with no key, hash or poll URL in them
Invariants: no key plaintext anywhere; garage money only; paid ≤ total; one Paynow request per collection; no "ZIG"
